subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer plus general explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or should these remain separate memory-plugin and channel-plugin improvements?
rationale: The request crosses memory authority, persisted rule storage, workspace-file precedence, conflict handling, and transport delivery policy; source inspection shows useful pieces but no current product contract for the proposed layer.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split Narrow Work
options.body: Use narrower issues and PRs for Feishu parser/delivery failures, and open a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want that product direction.

options.title: Route Through Plugin APIs
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning capability to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-sponsored design that defines rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available cross-surface history signal across memory docs, prompt/context behavior, and Feishu runtime boundaries.
